usefulness.definitions: per version v (2 versions): 12 task clauses = 2 tasks x {U0_S<v>, Ucal_S<v>} x {accuracy loss = accuracy(reference argmax) - accuracy(release argmax) <= 0.010; NLL excess = NLL(release) - NLL(reference) <= 0.010 nats (probability floor 1e-12); summed Brier excess = summed-over-classes Brier(release) - Brier(reference) <= 0.005}, and 2 within-SEX guards = occupation summed-Brier excess vs U0_S<v> among SEX 0 (men) and SEX 1 (women) <= 0.005; all inclusive; 28 = 2 x (12 + 2). sign_convention: NR's: pair benefit b = comparator AUC - candidate AUC (positive favours the candidate); recipient difference r = candidate AUC - comparator AUC (positive = the candidate's single view is more recoverable); paired costs loss(candidate) - loss(comparator) (negative favours the candidate; accuracy enters as a loss); bracket spend d = cost(CAND) - cost(point) (d <= 0: the point spends at least as much); learning-curve change d_LC = b(FULL FIT) - b(HALF FIT) (negative = the benefit shrinks when the readers get the larger auxiliary sample)

resampling_and_uncertainty.household: per registered cell, household bootstrap of SCORE (B = 400 replicates, households resampled, release, fitted readers, orientation and the VALIDATION-selected winner held fixed) gives the cell SE; se_hh = the RMS of the cell SEs with the cell weights of the aggregate (an upper bound under any cross-cell correlation; it does not shrink with more cells); conditional on everything fitted: it does not cover refitting readers, re-selecting the winner or refitting the release
resampling_and_uncertainty.reader_split_and_version: blocks = version x repetition (4 registered blocks), block mean = mean over reader seeds k0 / k1; se_rs = sqrt(sum_b (m_b - mean)^2 / 4): it contains the version difference (two release-fitting repeats), the reader-split difference (R1 / R2) and their interaction, and reader-seed variation only through the block means; each factor has about one degree of freedom
resampling_and_uncertainty.monte_carlo: se_mc from cell MC SEs of randomized releases (0 for deterministic releases)
resampling_and_uncertainty.se_agg: max(sqrt(se_hh^2 + se_rs^2 + se_mc^2), 0.001); 0 for an exact alias (ALIAS_ZERO, never positive)
resampling_and_uncertainty.resolved: aggregate mean - 2 se_agg > threshold and both version means > threshold (threshold 0 for D2 / D3, 0.020 for D4)
resampling_and_uncertainty.usefulness_ses: household-clustered SEs of each condition over MODEL_SELECT households (release fixed); MC SE in quadrature for randomized releases
resampling_and_uncertainty.bracket_ses: household-clustered SEs of MODEL_FIT out-of-fold paired costs: a selection device for the saved points, never an inference
resampling_and_uncertainty.not_replication: versions share every training row and the MODEL_SELECT people; repetitions R1-R4 deal the same people; reader seeds refit on the same households; MODEL_FIT folds and inner episodes overlap: none is an independent replication, and no fold or episode spread is used as an SE

reader_grid.seed_rule: reader seed S<v>k<k> = MODEL_SEED_BASE + 1200 + 10 v + k exactly (k0, k1 registered; k2, k3 robustness; 2026102405-2026102408, 2026102415-2026102418); recorded distinct integers; none equal to MODEL_SEED_BASE + {300, ..., 1100} + 10 v + k (k = 0..9; 180 seeds)
reader_grid.bootstrap_rule: household bootstrap of SCORE, B = 400 recorded, seed 2026102520 + 100 v + repetition index recorded per (version, repetition) as S<v><R> (2026102520-2026102523, 2026102620-2026102623; no seed shared with SAR1's 2026102400-03 / 2026102500-03 or DRF1's 2026102500-03 / 2026102600-03); the half-budget learning-curve cells reuse the same draws so their paired differences have a paired SE
reader_grid.robustness_cells: R3, R4 with k0-k3 and R1, R2 with k2, k3; never a decision input
reader_grid.validity: READER_SEEDS_EFFECTIVE iff the seed rule and the bootstrap rule hold (B recorded and 400) and, per seed pair, every seed-dependent recipe is checked and every seed-dependent equality is explained: off the minimum set by NRM1 A-SC1 (iii) or the few-valued explanation; on the minimum set by the extra-trees support explanation or the few-valued explanation; minimum set = a D2 reading's CAND, START, CONT and the saved STOPFIT, ALTCRIT and RAWJ points (for the refit: the D2R release and its decisive comparators); references are off it; claims need grid_valid recorded and exactly true

er_explanation.status: PROSPECTIVE (inherited from SAR1; registered before any grid output)
er_explanation.rule: extra-trees support: a seed-dependent k-pair equality on the minimum set is explained iff the recipe is ET5 or ET25, NRM1 (iii) (a) + (b) + (c) hold and the recorded distinct-input count of the view is at most 8001 // min_leaf; few-valued: an equality anywhere is explained iff the view's recorded distinct-input count is at most 320 and the same recipe differs on another wire or view in the same version, repetition and seed pair; explained equalities are counted once (n_eff); any other seed-dependent equality invalidates the grid

decisions.configuration: CAND = RF_FULL: the reader-fit-aware continuation of NEURAL_RAW (occupation network only; income bitwise START's) at k*, the largest checkpoint S_k whose every S_10..S_k keeps estimate + 2 household-clustered SE of the 5-fold MODEL_FIT out-of-fold occupation spends within SAR1 FB_PFO_R1's budgets (selection data MODEL_FIT_OOF; no SEX-recovery diagnostic); chosen before any MODEL_SELECT read; D1-D5 are read at CAND only

D1.rule: gating: G1 = all 28 original conditions at the point (NR.point_eligibility) at CAND; INCOMPLETE if CAND's selection data are not recorded or not a MODEL_FIT source; reported separately and never gating: the confidence conjunction (per condition from its own household-clustered SE, sqrt(se^2 + se_mc^2), no floor: PASS iff value + 2 se <= cap, VIOLATION iff value - 2 se > cap, else UNRESOLVED) and the inherited two-SE reserve heuristic of CAND, START and CONT; flags START_POINT_INELIGIBLE, CONT_POINT_INELIGIBLE, POINT_FEASIBLE_NOT_CONFIDENCE_RESOLVED, POINT_FEASIBLE_NOT_RESERVE_QUALIFIED, CAND_SELECTED_ON_MODEL_FIT_SEX_RECOVERY_DIAGNOSTIC (disclosure); NOT_FITTED_MECHANISM_INERT when the F0 gate stopped the family; flag CAND_SELECTED_ON_MODEL_FIT_SEX_RECOVERY_DIAGNOSTIC replaces the draft's CAND_SELECTED_ON_MODEL_FIT_SEX_DIAGNOSTIC; F0_SEX_BASED_FIT_GATE_DISCLOSED

D2.gating: START, CONT, STOPFIT, ALTCRIT (unless an exact alias of STOPFIT, shown by identical wires: its artifact is reused and the comparison counted once) and RAWJ, all gating; a gating control recorded as not run for budget gives NOT_ASSESSED_CONTROLS_NOT_RUN; a missing control not so recorded is INCOMPLETE
D2.paths: every PATH (STOPFIT, a PATH ALTCRIT, RAWJ) = origin START + its distinct saved points (aliases once; an alias of START collapses into it); two points saved per path and version before any MODEL_SELECT read on MODEL_FIT out-of-fold paired total-NLL spend over START: LO = the largest path point with spend <= CAND's (START counts as 0) and HI = the smallest with spend >= CAND's + 2 SE (SE = the household-clustered SE, same data, of that point's paired difference against CAND); on MODEL_SELECT Q* = NR.frontier_comparison's bracketing point

single_point_rule.rule: for a POINT ALTCRIT (selected by CAND's own MODEL_FIT rule): d = pooled MODEL_SELECT paired total-NLL cost(CAND) - cost(point); d <= 0 spend-matched or favourable; 0 < d and d - 2 SE <= 0 credited with flag ALTCRIT_SPENDS_LESS_UNRESOLVED; d - 2 SE > 0 NOT_SEPARATED (reason NOT_SEPARATED_FROM_SPEND; passed_if_spend_matched reported); otherwise pass iff AGG_POSITIVE pair benefit, both recipient gates and no secondary metric resolved higher than the point

D2.rule: met iff (a) G1 at CAND; (b) vs START and (b') vs CONT: nrm.rules.comparison passes (AGG_POSITIVE pair benefit: mean - 2 se_agg > 0 and both version means > 0; recipient gate: each single view r_v <= 0.010 per version at the aggregate point); (c) each gating PATH control: NR.frontier_comparison = DOMINATES_CONTROL_FRONTIER at Q* (AGG_POSITIVE vs Q*; no secondary metric resolved higher vs Q*) AND the recipient gate vs Q* AND no cheaper path point resolved less recoverable than CAND; a POINT control by the single-point rule; (d) reader targeting: the non-table winner's point pair benefit > 0 in both version means vs START, CONT and every gating Q* / point
D2.labels: in order: NOT_ASSESSED_NO_FEASIBLE_POINT; NOT_ASSESSED_EXACT_ALIAS; INCOMPLETE (CAND status, selection data or utility); NOT_ASSESSED_TASK_INFEASIBLE; NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_VALIDITY_UNKNOWN / NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_INVALID; INCOMPLETE (START not NEURAL_RAW, control kinds or ids malformed, an alias without its wire check); NOT_ASSESSED_CONTROLS_NOT_RUN; INCOMPLETE (a gating control's selection data not recorded or not allowed; any needed input); READER_TARGETED; COMPONENT_GAIN_BEYOND_START_AND_MECHANISM_CONTROLS; NOT_SEPARATED (no gating comparison passes); PARTIAL_<passed, joined by +, in the order START, CONT, STOPFIT, ALTCRIT, RAWJ>_ONLY
D2.no_bracket: a path whose every point spends less MODEL_SELECT total NLL than CAND has no bracket: that comparison reads NOT_SEPARATED (reason NO_BRACKET, flag NO_BRACKET_<key>): a limit of the control path, never evidence of equality or of no effect
D2.bounds: for every gating comparison the aggregate mean, se_agg and mean +- 2 se_agg are reported (development bounds for this procedure on reused people; not population bounds; not corrected for the adaptive search)
D2.partial: no partial outcome is a claim; NOT_SEPARATED is the default reading, never "equal"; without STOPFIT the fit-aware derivative is not isolated

grid_fineness.rule: per PATH control on MODEL_FIT out-of-fold paired costs before any MODEL_SELECT read: FINE iff LO >= 0.75 s (and <= s) and HI >= s + 2 SE and <= s + 2 SE + 0.25 s; COARSE_BELOW / COARSE_ABOVE / COARSE_BOTH; CONTROL_PATH_MAY_NOT_BRACKET (largest spend < s + 2 SE: extend the path before reading); SAVED_POINT_RULE_NOT_FOLLOWED; NOT_APPLICABLE_CAND_NOT_ABOVE_START; SELECTION_DATA_NOT_ALLOWED; INCOMPLETE; NOT_GIVEN; reported, never gating

D2.card_RF_RFIT_v1: STOPFIT = [RF_STOP_LO, RF_STOP_HI]; ALTCRIT = [RF_ALTC_HI] and RAWJ = [RF_RAWJ_HI], each with LO recorded on MODEL_FIT but not saved (lo_not_saved; flag LO_NOT_SAVED_SPEC_BUDGET_<key>; their cheaper-point check (c3) then covers START only); a bracket point that does not exist is not saved (the path is read on START and the saved points; a missing HI usually gives NO_BRACKET); ALTCRIT is a NEAR_ALIAS of STOPFIT iff the recorded median relative critic lag on the deployed fit is < 0.01: it still gates (an intersection can only be harder) but is never counted as an independent control (flag ALTCRIT_NEAR_ALIAS_OF_STOPFIT_NOT_INDEPENDENT, scope sentence D2_SCOPE_NEAR_ALIAS); a declared altcrit_near_alias disagreeing with the lag rule is INCOMPLETE; lag not recorded: flag ALTCRIT_LAG_NOT_RECORDED

LC.rule: budgets fixed before any outcome: FULL = the declared FIT part, HALF = FIT fraction 0.5 by the inherited RFA1_devgrid_LC fold rule (the FIT households in folds 0-1 of 4; HALF within FIT; the 0.25 fraction is not run; VALIDATION, SCORE, recipes, seeds and bootstrap draws unchanged); read at CAND when D2 reached its conjuncts, on the registered cells, against START, CONT, every gating Q* / point and H_LJ; per comparator d_LC = b(FULL) - b(HALF) per cell, SE the paired-bootstrap SE when recorded for every cell else sqrt(se_FULL^2 + se_HALF^2) (flag LC_SE_UNPAIRED_BOUND), aggregated by NR.aggregate: BENEFIT_SHRINKS_RESOLVED (upper bound < 0 and both version means < 0), BENEFIT_SHRINKS_POINT (mean < 0), NO_SHRINKAGE_AT_POINT; limitation iff the full-budget point benefit > 0 and mean d_LC < 0; family LEARNABILITY_LIMITATION if any limitation (headline caveat), INCOMPLETE if a comparator is missing, else NO_SHRINKAGE_SEEN (never evidence of information removal; budgets above the declared FIT untested); the inner episodes' auxiliary training size is recorded (flags LC_INNER_EPISODE_SIZE_NOT_RECORDED, INNER_EPISODE_BUDGET_AT_LEAST_EVALUATION_FIT); descriptive, never changes D1-D6 or the class

D2R.rule: trigger fixed now: read at CAND whenever CAND is G1-feasible and the registered grid is valid (budget permitting; a skipped D2R reads NOT_RUN and is disclosed); decisive set {START, CONT, the registered STOPFIT, ALTCRIT (unless an alias) and RAWJ brackets or point}, never re-chosen; ROBUSTNESS_CONFIRMED per comparator iff nrm.rules.robustness confirms (AGG_POSITIVE on the robustness cells and on all cells), both recipient gates hold on the robustness cells, the registered cells are present and refit_effectiveness is REFIT_GENUINELY_EFFECTIVE; sign changes and robustness recipient failures (decisive or beside) are carried into the headline; descriptive; never changes D2

D3.rule: NRM1 G4 at CAND (every point-eligible reference by the published point labels, all nine; no reserve rule removes a reference: AGG_POSITIVE pair benefit and the recipient gate, intersection-union) with the reader-budget credit rule; SUPERIOR_TO_ALL_ELIGIBLE_REFERENCES only if every one passes; the references passed and failed are listed; START = NEURAL_RAW is one of the nine

D4.rule: NRM1 G5 at CAND with the reader-budget credit rule: MATERIAL_0020_RESOLVED iff against each of NEURAL_RAW and H_LJ the aggregate mean - 2 se_agg > 0.020 and both version means > 0.020, with both recipient gates; smaller gains keep their own level (MATERIAL_0020_POINT_ONLY, POSITIVE_BELOW_MATERIAL_TARGET, NOT_MET); never weakened

decisions.D5: NRM1 G6 unchanged only when a card claims joint design (a local twin and both sequential orders built); RFA1 plans no local twin: NOT_APPLICABLE_NOT_JOINT (no joint-design claim)
decisions.D6: NOT_CLAIMED unless a separate prior-art review supplies NOVELTY_REVIEW_PENDING / NOVEL_PER_SEPARATE_REVIEW / PRIOR_ART_FOUND; never inferred from performance

F0.rule: card RF_RFIT_v1 5: before any arm is fitted, 64 MODEL_FIT episodes at START (8 groups; unbiased cross-group estimates); MECHANISM_INERT iff the orthogonal share < 0.05 and cos(E g_tot, E g_dir) > 0.995; an inert version saves nothing, so a reading with any inert version is MECHANISM_INERT (D1 NOT_FITTED_MECHANISM_INERT, D2-D5 and the learning curve NOT_ASSESSED_MECHANISM_INERT, class MECHANISM_INERT; flag MECHANISM_INERT_IN_ONE_VERSION_ONLY); a FITTED reading with an inert version, or MECHANISM_INERT without the record, is INCOMPLETE; a SEX-based MODEL_FIT gate that decides only whether the family is fitted, never an operating point (disclosed)

falsifiers.rule: the card's registered falsifiers, reported in decisions()['falsifiers'] and as FALSIFIER_<k>_TRIGGERED flags, never changing a label or the class: F0 from the F0 record; F2 (no resolved FULL benefit over STOPFIT at matched spend) TRIGGERED iff the STOPFIT frontier label at Q* is neither DOMINATES_CONTROL_FRONTIER nor SEPARATED_ON_PRIMARY_COST_ONLY (NOT_ASSESSABLE_NO_BRACKET without a bracket); F4 TRIGGERED iff the learning curve reads LEARNABILITY_LIMITATION; F1, F3, F5, F6 as recorded by the coordinator (falsifier_records), else NOT_RECORDED

outcome_class.rule: first applicable: MECHANISM_INERT (the F0 gate stopped the family); TASK_INFEASIBLE; SELECTED_POINT_INFEASIBLE; INCOMPLETE (D1 incomplete, D2 incomplete or not computed); NO_OUTPUT_CHANGE (CAND = START exactly); MECHANISM_NOT_ASSESSED (a gating control not run); INCOMPLETE (D3 undecided); COMPETITIVE_CANDIDATE (D2 met and D3 met); MECHANISM_COMPONENT_NOT_COMPETITIVE (D2 met, D3 not); REFERENCE_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ATTRIBUTED (D3 met, D2 not; partial = D2's label); BOUNDED_NEGATIVE_EXPERIMENT (otherwise; partial = D2's label: NOT_SEPARATED, READER_TARGETED or PARTIAL_<passed>_ONLY, with the development bounds); D4, D5, D6, D2R and the learning curve never change the class; the five outcomes (usefulness, gain beyond the mechanism-specific controls, strong references, material target, joint design and novelty) are always reported separately in 'outcomes' with one statement
flags: the D1, D2, D5, learning-curve and MC flags

registration_status.registered: a reading is registered iff it is revision 0 of RFA (card RF_RFIT_v1; the code family FAM is the same family, canonicalised to RFA, so two registered readings under the two names are refused) and its card was committed before any MODEL_SELECT outcome of this campaign; the one planned substantive revision R1 (with its own isolating control) is REVISED_R1 if its card preceded every MODEL_SELECT outcome, else ADAPTIVE_R1; a family name other than RFA, FAM or FS_<letters/digits> is refused
registration_status.tag: otherwise <KIND>_<parts> (REVISED / ADAPTIVE; FS, R<n>, R0_LATE_CARD); every label prefixed <tag>__
registration_status.multiplicity: one AGG_POSITIVE comparison passes a true null in about 0.07-2% of replicates under six moderate NRM1 known laws and about 8% when one version or split dominates (NRM1 RULES.md 5.5); a D2 look is an intersection-union conjunction of up to five such comparisons plus reader targeting, so its false-pass rate is at most that of its weakest member; with K D2 looks the chance that at least one passes by chance is at most K times the per-look rate; no multiplicity correction is applied or claimed

scope: Lower recovery for the declared development readers is not protection against every reader.
MODEL_SELECT is adaptively used: development evidence, never confirmation.
Versions share training rows; repetitions share households; reader recipes and overlapping splits are not independent datasets.
A reserve-frontier result is not superiority over every historical method.
Novelty is never inferred from performance.
A lower reader AUC is evidence about the declared finite-data reader procedure and its auxiliary budget, not an arbitrary-attacker guarantee and not information removal.
Point feasibility, the confidence conjunction and the reserve heuristic are separate results.
A revision or replacement-family reading is never the registered result.
The five outcomes (usefulness, gain beyond the mechanism-specific controls, strong references, material target, joint design and novelty) are reported separately; none implies another.
change_record: family RFA (START = NEURAL_RAW, frozen), one MODEL_FIT-selected operating point per version; UM, the strength machinery, strongest_nonzero and CALIBRATION bracket data removed

D2 gates on START, CONT (always gating) and the matched mechanism controls STOPFIT (PATH), ALTCRIT (PATH, POINT by the DRF1 single-point spend rule, or an exact alias of STOPFIT counted once) and RAWJ (PATH, SAR1's ALT); met label COMPONENT_GAIN_BEYOND_START_AND_MECHANISM_CONTROLS; partials named by what passed; development bounds reported
new: the learning-curve reading (FULL vs a fixed HALF of FIT), a shrinking benefit carried into the headline as a learnability limitation
D2R: the decisive set adds every gating control; robustness recipient gates required and their failures carried into the headline (DRF1); the beside list is de-duplicated (DRF1's cosmetic defect)

five separately reported outcomes; outcome classes COMPETITIVE_CANDIDATE, MECHANISM_COMPONENT_NOT_COMPETITIVE, REFERENCE_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ATTRIBUTED, BOUNDED_NEGATIVE_EXPERIMENT (with D2's partial name), MECHANISM_NOT_ASSESSED, SELECTED_POINT_INFEASIBLE
